english:
Thanks a lot to Jesus and Mother. My name is Meenu Mathew. I belong to St. Sebastian’s Church parish, Shanthinagar, Ernakulam. My son’s name is Hayden Manu. I first took the Covenant here on November 6, 2019.
The first intention I placed in the Covenant was about my son. My son was not speaking.
He did not speak until the age of four. That is, he would say only one or two words — he would just call me “Amme” (Mother) and that was all.
I was in great difficulty because all the other children of his age had already started speaking in sentences, but he was not speaking. So,
one of the intentions I placed in the Covenant was that my little one should start speaking. We came here to Kreupasanam and began to pray. One day, when my husband, my child, and I came for prayer, Fr. Joseph was walking by.
My husband and I ran to him and said, “Father, he is not speaking.”
Then Fr. Joseph placed his hands on my child’s throat, made the sign of the Cross, prayed, tapped him gently, and said, “He will speak now; there will be no problem.” After that,
we went home and every day during the apparition prayer, we offered him and prayed. Along with that, we gave him all the covenant items — the Mother’s anointing oil,
honey, and holy salt — every day like medicine. We gave them to him daily, and then he started speaking. After that, I admitted him to school. He began to speak only after the age of four.
After that, I enrolled him in school. When he joined LKG and all, he wouldn’t study at all. When he opened a book, he wouldn’t look at it. In the same way, he wasn’t learning.
When he started to study, he would begin to cry. He had no concentration at all. Then, the sister who was teaching in his class told us to get his IQ level tested. At that time,
my child had been perfectly fine since birth, without any problems. So when they said that his IQ level needed to be tested, I was deeply troubled. I went for the test with great fear.
When the IQ level test was done, they said that he was two years behind. Hearing that and telling everyone at home,
I was terribly upset. I wondered what I would do — they were saying that my child was two years delayed.
Then, we all prayed earnestly to Mother and started praying with the covenant items — honey, holy salt, and oil. After that, with that IQ test report,
we came here. I came along with my father and mother. We brought that report and showed it to Fr. Joseph.
When we showed him the report, Father placed his hand on the child’s head, prayed, and said, “Now you must come back and give testimony.” After that, in 2022, I went to Muscat for work. I
left my child in my mother’s care. It was very hard for me — I kept worrying, since I wasn’t there, how would he study? I was so anxious.
After I went, I prayed a lot there to Jesus and Mother, saying, “Jesus, Mother, only if You touch my child will he be healed.”
At home, my mother used to place Mother’s covenant medal on his chest and pray for him.
After two or three days of my prayers, when I called home after a few days, my mother said that the child had spoken — that he saw Jesus in his dream, and Jesus came
and touched his forehead and took something away from it. After that, my child began to learn. Earlier, he would just scribble a single line in his book, nothing more.
He didn’t know even the ABCDs. We didn’t know how we would ever teach him. Then my mother began teaching him each letter,
always praying with Mother’s covenant medal placed nearby, and giving him the covenant oil, honey, and holy salt daily. When she sat him down to study, he would cry a lot
and showed no attention to the book. But after that, through the power of prayer through Holy Mother,
My child began to write letters quickly, and then we took him back to school. Earlier, they had refused him admission, saying that since his IQ level was low,
he couldn’t be taught. So, we brought him home, prayed to Mother, and taught him all the letters through prayer.
Then we again applied for his school admission. At that time, the sister there said, “He won’t be able to study. How can I give him admission?” Then my father and mother said, “He is learning now. There is no problem with him.”
Then the sister said, “If he can write the letters, only then I’ll admit him to first standard.” So,
as the sister said, he wrote all the letters, and all the sisters who saw it were amazed, saying, “He is studying so well now!” And then he was given admission.
After getting admission, now he is studying very well in first standard as a good student. And now, after coming here,
I took part in Mother’s rally, and in his midterm exam, he scored very good marks — he lost only two or three marks. This was something I never expected. Mother has
blessed my son so abundantly, and I am deeply grateful to Mother and to Jesus. The second testimony is about my job. I had written to Mother asking that I should pass my OET exam.
I wanted to get a good job abroad, because even though I was working here, the salary was very low. I had to look after my child and also manage the household.
I didn’t know what to do. So, I had a strong desire to go abroad. I studied for the OET exam, but my score was always low.
With this low score, I thought maybe I could go to the UK as a senior carer under the caregiver visa. But deep in my heart,
I always wanted to work as a nurse, because I am a nurse by profession. I applied, but that also got cancelled. After that, one day around 3 PM, I prayed the apparition prayer to Mother,
saying, “Mother, please give me a job — anywhere, it doesn’t matter, any job is enough.” After that, my sister from Muscat called me
and said, “You come, it’s fine. I’ll bring you here on a visiting visa. Right now, they are recruiting nurses for government hospitals.” She told me not to worry and to come.
So my sister brought me there, kept me in her own house, and both my sister and brother-in-law helped me with everything I needed.
From there, I began to pray. At that time, I was a bit distracted and not very regular in prayer. Then my sister told me, “You must pray.
If you pray well, whatever it is, you will surely get this job.” She took me for the Prometric exam and helped me appear for it. The first two times, I failed.
Then, before the third attempt, I began to go more often to church, prayed the apparition prayer, and started reading the Bible. Through my Mother’s intercession, that exam went very smoothly —
I didn’t even realize how easily it went. Mother helped me to pass that exam smoothly. After that, I immediately got an interview call.
I prayed before going for the interview, saying, “Mother and Jesus, You both must come and attend this interview for me, because I don’t know anything. It’s an Arabic place —
I don’t know what they will ask, or what kind of questions there will be.” Because I had only worked in a few hospitals and clinics before,
I didn’t have much exposure. I had no idea what they would ask or how to answer. Then, during the interview, there were two Omanis — one male and one female —
who interviewed me. They asked me only three questions in total, and they were all questions I knew very well. It was truly my Jesus and my Mother themselves asked me those questions.
I answered them easily and passed the interview. Right then, they told me, “You are passed.” Usually, people say that for a government job,
even after the interview, it can take about six months to get the result. But for me, through my Mother’s grace, within the very next month itself, I received an email about both my interview result and exam approval.
On June 26 itself, I was able to join for work. Now I am working in a good hospital in Oman. Among all those working with me,
I am the one with the least experience. Everyone else has much more experience than me. But my Mother made sure that I stood first and performed well. She helped me to work smartly,
even though I was very afraid at first. During the first three months, we had to stay under a trainer’s supervision, and only after that would we be confirmed for the job.
During those three months, I was very scared. I didn’t know many things, and there was a lot of work. I was really frightened, wondering how I would manage. Everything there had to be done very quickly,
not like in our country — there was so much to do. I didn’t know what to do. But whenever I felt scared, I would call home and ask my father and mother to pray that I could manage there.
As a result of all those prayers, I always carried Mother’s covenant medal with me. I kept it inside the pocket of my coat and never went anywhere without it.
I would make the sign of the Cross on my forehead with the covenant oil, recite the Creed, and say Mother’s apparition prayer before leaving for work.
Because of that, I can now do all my work quickly and without any difficulty. I am so grateful to my Jesus and Mother for everything they have done for me.
Another blessing I received was healing from a severe illness. I had unbearable stomach pain in 2021.
Every night, exactly at one o’clock, the pain would start. It was so bad that I couldn’t bear it. I would hold the covenant medal in my hand and lie down, praying constantly, “Mother, I can’t bear this pain.”
Because of the stomach pain, even when I went to work, I had to return home. At that time, I was working in a clinic. I told my sir there that I couldn’t continue.
I was afraid I might lose my job. I used to tell him, “Sir, what will I do?” But the pain was so unbearable that I had no choice but to tell him that I couldn’t stand and work anymore.
Because in that clinic, we had to stand for long hours to assist the doctor, and with that stomach pain, I simply couldn’t stand and continue.
Every evening and night, I used to feel scared to go to bed because I knew that by one o’clock, the stomach pain would begin. I was terrified. One night, my husband took me to a nearby hospital.
They gave me an injection, and only after that pain-relief injection could I feel a little better — only then could I sleep.
Everyone told me to consult a gastroenterologist, so I went to see one at a medical centre in Ernakulam. The doctor advised some treatments,
but when I returned home, I thought of my Mother and decided, “I don’t need any medicine, because I have faith in my Mother.” So that evening,
I prayed and told Mother, “Your blessed salt alone is enough for me. Through this, take away my pain forever so that it never returns.” I put a little of the blessed salt in a small glass of water,
prayed, recited the Creed, and drank it with faith. That night, I didn’t wake up at one o’clock — I slept peacefully. From that day onward,
I never again experienced that terrible stomach pain, which used to be an unbearable, burning pain. I was afraid of it before, but since taking Mother’s salt like medicine,
I have been completely healed. Mother, a thousand thanks to You! Jesus, thank You for all Your blessings! Praise You, Lord!
After receiving these graces, I also began doing works of charity. Whenever someone comes to me with any hardship or need,
I try to help financially as much as I can — for example, when schools reopen, I help children by buying their books and paying their school expenses.
When I give Mother’s paper (newsletters), I always pray, make the sign of the Cross, and say, “Mother, please bless these people.
Let there be peace in their families and may all their needs be fulfilled.” I give it prayerfully. I also distribute the blessed medals to my colleagues after praying. Thankyou Mother, Thankyou Jesus.
Wisdom 10:21: “Wisdom opened the mouth of the dumb and made the tongues of infants speak clearly.”
This is the living testimony of Meenu Mathew, brought to the altar of Kreupasanam before the Blessed Mother — a testimony of faithfulness, trust, dedication, and sincerity in the Covenant.
When that child lived with covenant faith and used the blessed objects, the Mother of Mercy worked wonders through the Mighty One — the child who could not speak began to speak!
Likewise, when you too live in faith, fidelity, and sincere devotion to the Covenant, the Lord who is faithful to His promises and rich in mercy will surely act.
The Lord upholds those who fall and lifts up those who are bowed down. Through the Blessed Mother, let us clap our hands and thank Jesus for these great graces.
